primary_analysis: Confirmatory paired analysis (complete-pair only) using the executor's paired-proportion procedure on paired_binary_episode_v1 results: compute paired success-rate difference (guarded − baseline), report point estimate, 95% CI, and p-value using the registered paired-proportion / permutation routine. Analysis uses completed pairs = completed_episode_count/2 (200 pairs) per execution manifest. All inputs drawn from execution/raw_results.jsonl and deterministic validator traces.
secondary_analyses: Per-validator false-positive rate (FP-rate) averaged across tasks (exploratory/registered secondary)
Per-validator false-negative rate (FN-rate) averaged across tasks (exploratory/registered secondary)
Mean detection latency per validator (ms), averaged across tasks (registered secondary)
Linear/robust regression predicting simulated operational-impact score from validator metric vectors; report adjusted R^2 and regression coefficients (registered secondary)
AUC for operational-impact-thresholded outcomes derived from validator-metric predictor (registered secondary)
sensitivity_analyses: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity: treat any missing or incomplete guarded episode as failure (0) for guarded condition and recompute primary estimand (pre-registered sensitivity)
Bootstrap stability: 1,000 bootstrap resamples of paired tasks to derive empirical SEs and CIs for primary and secondary estimands (registered sensitivity)
Include contamination-flagged episodes analysis: recompute primary and secondary estimands on full dataset including episodes flagged/ excluded by contamination checks (exploratory sensitivity)
uncertainty_quantification: Bootstrap with 1,000 resamples to produce empirical standard errors and 95% confidence intervals for primary and secondary estimands; report p-value from the executor's paired-permutation test for the primary estimand; report bootstrap CIs for adjusted R^2 and AUC.
multiplicity_implementation: Single pre-registered primary estimand (paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline). All subgroup, per-error-class, per-validator, and cost-parameter tests are exploratory. When reporting multiple p-values for exploratory tests, control false discovery rate using Benjamini–Hochberg; otherwise report effect sizes and CIs without formal multiplicity claims.
contamination_analysis: Apply deterministic contamination detection as preregistered: exclude exact-duplicate outputs by output_sha256 (SHA-256) and semantic duplicates with embedding cosine > 0.95; exclusions and deterministic replacements follow the preregistered replacement index rule and are logged in execution/execution_log.jsonl. Validators are evaluated against a held-out generator set; any validator with >20 percentage-point FP/FN divergence is relegated to exploratory-only analyses. All contamination/exclusion logs and affected episode identifiers published alongside raw_results.jsonl.
table_specifications: Table 1 — Primary confirmatory result: paired success-rate difference (guarded − baseline), point estimate, 95% CI, p-value, n_pairs=200 (derived from execution manifest completed_episode_count=400). Source: execution/raw_results.jsonl

Table 2 — Per-validator summary metrics (exploratory/secondary): FP-rate, FN-rate, mean detection latency (ms), per-validator sample counts; averages computed across tasks. Source: deterministic_validator_trace in raw_results.jsonl

Table 3 — Predictive model results (secondary): regression coefficients, adjusted R^2, standard errors, and AUC for operational-impact-thresholded outcome; bootstrap CIs (1,000 resamples). Source: raw_results.jsonl and simulated operational-impact scores recorded in artifacts

Table 4 — Contamination and exclusion summary: counts of SHA-256 exact duplicates, semantic-similarity exclusions (cosine>0.95), replacements applied, and any validators relegated to exploratory status due to >20pp divergence. Source: execution/execution_log.jsonl and contamination logs
